content:
Jen: quick fun poll: if we held an office costume party where people dressed as model archetypes, who would you be?
Marcus: I'm going as 'BeamSearch Barry' — perfectly polite, predictably correct, refuses to deviate. tie and sweater vest. :necktie:
Rae: 'Hallucination Hattie' — sequined cape, makes up a backstory for every chair. brings glitter. :sparkles:
DesignLina: I'll make stickers: tiny vending-machine KV cache, a snack-laden cache chest.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: event note: do not power-cycle the RGB server during the conga line. :warning:
Jen: bonus: what one prop does each character carry?
Marcus: BeamSearch Barry: clipboard with bullet points.
Rae: Hallucination Hattie: a fake golden key that "unlocks" any puzzle.
DesignLina: Distilled Dee: a pocket-sized handbook titled "1-line pep talk".
Jen: vote with emoji: :one: Barry clipboard, :two: Hattie's golden key, :three: Dee's handbook.
ops-bot: event-bot: RSVP updated: 10 humans, 2 bots, 1 overenthusiastic hallucination. :tada:
Rae: also can we get a prize for "best prompt cosplay"? tiny ribbon with a prompt icon.
Marcus: agreed. I'll host a mini runway describing each costume in exactly 20 tokens.
Jen: perfect. @DesignLina pls add sticker task to your queue. I'll bring non-lethal confetti. :confetti_ball:
